name: Hiiragi Kanna
source:
3rd year high school student.
She's always dreamed of winning the Kushikou Prince Collection with her own hands, and that's why she transferred into the academy.
She's obsessed with the Prince Collection contest and is always following around the other contestants with her underling [url=/c49318]Seiki[/url] in tow.
translation:
3rd year high school student.
She's always dreamed of winning the Kushikou Prince Collection with her own hands, and that's why she transferred into the academy.
She's obsessed with the Prince Collection contest and is always following around the other contestants with her underling [url=/c49318]Seiki[/url] in tow.
